title: NALSA — Assistance for Women

service_context.subject: Free legal assistance for women
service_context.purpose: Information on how women facing legal issues can approach Legal Services Institutions for free legal assistance.
service_context.important_note: This source provides information about accessing legal services. It is not a source for determining legal entitlement or predicting a court outcome.

nearest_legal_services_authority.description: Women facing legal issues can approach Legal Services Institutions at different levels.
nearest_legal_services_authority.support: Panel Lawyers or Paralegal Volunteers can assist with the process.

online_application.description: Women can apply for free legal aid online through the official NALSA portal.

nalsa_helpline.description: Toll-free National Legal Aid Helpline through which callers can speak with a Panel Lawyer for guidance.

legal_aid_clinics.description: Legal Aid Clinics are available in locations including villages, colleges, jails and NGOs.
support: Assist in filling legal aid applications
Connect applicants with an appropriate lawyer

application_tracking.description: After applying online or offline, the applicant receives a Diary Number that can be used to track progress and follow up with the relevant Legal Services Authority.

rag_use: Answer questions about where women can seek free legal assistance.
Identify the appropriate level of Legal Services Institution based on the available location information.
Provide the official NALSA helpline number when appropriate.
Explain that legal aid clinics can help with applications and connecting applicants with lawyers.
Explain that an applicant can track an application using the Diary Number.
Provide a citation to the official NALSA source when this information is retrieved.

application_to_alimony_plus.routing_rule: When a user appears to need legal representation or legal advice beyond the AI's safe scope, the system may provide NALSA legal-aid access information and encourage appropriate human legal assistance.
application_to_alimony_plus.safety_rule: The AI must not claim that NALSA will accept, win, or resolve a particular case. It should provide the official access information without guaranteeing an outcome.
application_to_alimony_plus.human_review: Questions requiring legal advice, representation, interpretation of individual facts, or urgent safety intervention should be routed to an appropriate human professional or relevant emergency/support service.
